description: Every unit test pays a per-test cost that grows with the number of tests already run on its xdist worker. Four autouse fixtures in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/conftest.py (isolated_claude_home, isolated_env_file_dir, isolated_layered_config and feature_worktree_cwd when listed) call tmp_path_factory.mktemp, and pytest's numbered-directory helper lists the whole worker base temp directory on every call to find the next free number. Each test adds three or more entries, so the work is quadratic in the tests per worker: a worker ends a run with 10,000 to 12,600 entries. Measured on main at 412bed21 on an 18-core macOS host: 4,200 empty tests run in 56.4 s through the suite's conftest and in 5.7 s with a constant-time numbered directory; in the full unit selection at '-n 3' the median test fell from 26 ms to 3 ms and the tenth percentile from 9 ms to 2 ms, and the summed time of the 6,588 tests that start no git process fell from 259 s to 171 s. On CI the floor is the same shape: the tenth-percentile test takes 7.3 ms on ubuntu-latest (2 xdist workers) and 9.3 ms on macos-latest (3 workers), the 25th percentile 12.0 ms and 16.7 ms. The workspace-survival job's survival child runs the same 8,300 tests on 2 workers and pays it too.
goal: Make the per-test temporary directories of the suite's autouse fixtures cost the same for the first and the last test of a worker. Preferred design: the autouse fixtures that only need a private empty directory get it from one constant-time helper (one per-test directory created with a counter or tempfile.mkdtemp under the worker's base temp, the three needs sharing one parent where that keeps their isolation), and the suite's numbered-directory creation (including the built-in tmp_path) no longer lists the base temp directory per call, for example a session-level replacement of pytest's numbered-directory helper that keeps a per-prefix counter and still never reuses a name. Keep every isolation guarantee the fixtures give today: each test gets its own empty HOME, env-file directory and layered-config directory; directories stay under the worker's base temp; xdist workers never share one. Test-harness code only. Module line budgets (holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json) are frozen: that file is never changed; a module this change touches stays within its limit, and new helper code goes into new modules rather than growing an existing one past its limit.
rationale: The overhead is paid by all 8,300 unit tests in three CI jobs (unit on ubuntu, unit on macOS and the workspace-survival child run), and it grows with every test added. Estimated from the CI per-test floor: about 40 s off the ubuntu unit job, about 38 s off the macOS unit job and about 35 s off the workspace-survival job per pipeline run, more as the suite grows.
acceptance_criteria: The execution notes report, before and after, the wall time of 4,200 empty tests run serially through the suite's conftest and the tenth-percentile, median and summed test time of the full unit selection at '-n 2' and '-n 3' from 'uv run pytest -m "not integration_test and not stress" --junitxml=<report>' on the same machine (median of at least three alternating runs). The empty-test run is at least 5 times faster and the median unit test at least 3 times cheaper.

A unit test proves that the time to create a test's temporary directories does not grow with the number of directories already in the base temp (for example creating 5,000 then timing the next 100 against the first 100), and that two consecutive tests never get the same directory.

Every isolation guarantee is kept and proved by the existing guard tests: per-test HOME, env-file and layered-config directories are distinct, empty at test start and under the worker base temp; the stress and hermetic-canary support tests still pass.

After the change, the CI per-test floor is re-measured from the unit-report JUnit of the pull request's own run on ubuntu-latest and macos-latest, and the 'Run unit tests' step time is compared with the last three runs on main; both are in the pull request body.
No file under apps/sandbox-executor/src is changed. holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json is unchanged and no touched module exceeds its limit.

The whole unit selection passes with 'uv run pytest -n auto --dist worksteal -m "not integration_test and not stress"' and serially with '-p no:xdist' for tests/test_fast_tmp_dirs.py; 'uv run task lint' and 'uv run task lint-docs' pass.
